ui.heroTitle: Mai ciro hoto ƙarami na YouTube
ui.heroIntro: Sauke hotunan ƙanana na YouTube da nan take a mafi girman ingancin da ake da shi, kyauta. Ciro ka ajiye hotunan HD daga kowace bidiyo ta YouTube ta jama'a, Shorts ko URL na da dannawa ɗaya. Saka hanya a ƙasa, danna Samo hoto ƙarami, sa'an nan sauke ko raba hanyar da ta shirya.

ui.INVALID_VIDEO_ID: Ba a sami ingantaccen ID ɗin bidiyo a cikin wannan hanyar ba.
ui.THUMBNAIL_NOT_FOUND: Ba a sami hoto ƙarami na jama'a na wannan bidiyo ba.
ui.NETWORK_ERROR: Kuskuren hanyar sadarwa ya tsaya nema. Gwada kuma.
ui.TIMEOUT: Neman hoto ƙarami ya ƙare lokaci. Gwada kuma.
ui.IMAGE_VALIDATION_FAILED: Ba a iya tabbatar da hoto ƙarami a matsayin hoto ingantacce ba.
ui.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Ba a iya sauke fayil ɗin ba. Buɗe hoton.
ui.CHANNEL_OR_PLAYLIST: Saka URL ɗin bidiyo, ba hanyar tashar ko jerin wasa ba.
